WhatsApp message fees

Meta charges for some WhatsApp messages (for example marketing and utility templates) at rates that vary by country. These are billed by Meta to your WhatsApp Business account, not by Selo. Selo shows you an estimate before every campaign and tracks your spend.

Free trial

Try any plan free for 14 days. Cancel from Shopify at any time.

Pricing questions

Do I need a WhatsApp Business account?

You need a WhatsApp Business Platform account. You create or connect it during setup by signing in with your Meta account.

What do WhatsApp messages cost?

Meta charges for some messages, such as marketing and utility templates, at rates that vary by country. Selo shows an estimate before every campaign and tracks what you spend.

Can I change plans?

Yes. Upgrade or downgrade any time from the app; Shopify adjusts your bill.

What happens when the AI budget runs out?

You choose: keep AI suggestions only, or turn the AI off until next month. Your automations and campaigns keep running either way.

Do you charge per message?

No. You pay the plan fee only; Meta bills WhatsApp message fees to your WhatsApp Business account.

Is there a setup fee?

No.
